environment.description: Same Flask application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The task IAM role has no relevance to the SQLi issue. The critical controls are: (1) An AWS AppSync-style request mapping enforced by an API Gateway HTTP integration with a request validator that rejects any request where the 'q' query parameter length exceeds 32 characters OR contains characters outside [a-zA-Z0-9@._\-\s]; (2) The API Gateway resource policy restricts invoke access to a specific VPC endpoint (vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f), meaning only internal traffic routed through that endpoint can reach the API; (3) A CloudWatch Logs metric filter on the application log group triggers an automatic rollback via CodeDeploy if error rate exceeds 2% in any 60-second window, which would fire on repeated SQL errors from injection attempts.

config.vpc_endpoint: vpce-0a1b2c3d4e5f, private DNS enabled, attached to internal subnets only
config.network: private subnets only, no IGW, NAT gateway for egress
